content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

That's solid fitness knowledge, Alex! The general consensus is 0.7–1g of protein per pound of bodyweight (roughly 1.6–2.2g per kg) to maximize muscle growth when you're training hard and eating enough overall calories.

Since your goal is hitting 100kg on bench press in 3 months, nail your protein intake, hit your lifts consistently, and let the data speak—track your lifts and bodyweight on the app to see what's working. 💪
